items.name: ConfigName
items.summary: The name of an entry in the top-level `configs` map of a build system response. Targets refer to their config by name so that a config shared by many targets is sent, stored, and parsed only once.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.signature: fn deserialize<D: Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>

items.name: ModulePathCache
items.summary: A `ModulePath` is optimised so that equal paths compare equal with `Arc::ptr_eq`, that only works if we reuse the `ModulePath` and don't create new ones each time. Use this cache to ensure we are reusing them.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.signature: fn deserialize<D: Deserializer<'de>>(deserializer: D) -> Result<Self, D::Error>

methods.name: serialize
methods.signature: fn serialize<S: Serializer>(&self, serializer: S) -> Result<S::Ok, S::Error>

items.name: LiveSourceDatabase
items.summary: Source database functionality for build-system-backed databases that can be queried again as the project changes.

methods.name: get_config
methods.summary: Get the raw JSON for a named config. Callers are expected to deserialize the result once and key their own cache on the [`ConfigName`], since there may be many targets per config and many lookups per target.

methods.name: get_generated_files
methods.summary: Get any generated files for which we might have to override the config finder.

methods.name: get_paths_to_watch
methods.summary: The source database-related configuration files a watcher should wait for changes on. Changes to one of these returned watchfiles should force a sourcedb rebuild.

methods.name: get_target
methods.summary: Get the target for the given [`ModulePath`], if one exists.

methods.name: get_target_config_name
methods.summary: Get the name of the config that applies to the target owning the given file.

methods.name: get_target_root
methods.summary: Get the per-target root for the target that owns the given file.

methods.name: query_source_db
methods.signature: fn query_source_db(&self, files: SmallSet<InternedPath>, force: bool) -> (anyhow::Result<bool>, TelemetrySourceDbRebuildInstanceStats)
methods.summary: Queries this sourcedb for the provided set of open files. Will short-circuit querying if there are no changes from the set of files previously queried for, unless `force` is provided, which will unconditionally requery the source DB.

items.name: ModuleEnumerator
items.summary: A source database that can enumerate the module handles that should seed a checking run.

items.name: SourceDatabase
items.summary: Represents a virtual filesystem provided by a build system. A build system should understand the relationship between targets and importable qualified paths to the files contained in the build system.

methods.name: as_live_source_database
methods.summary: Returns live source database functionality, when this source database can be queried again.

methods.name: handle_from_module_path
methods.summary: Get the handle for the given module path, including its Python platform and version settings.

methods.name: lookup
methods.signature: fn lookup(&self, module: ModuleName, origin: Option<&Path>, style_filter: Option<ModuleStyle>) -> Option<ModulePath>
methods.summary: Find the given module in the sourcedb, given the module it's originating from.

methods.name: may_contain_module
methods.summary: Return whether this source database may contain `module`.
